name: cloud-monitor-backend
description: Cloudflare Pages Functions + cron Worker backend for the Cloud Monitor system

scripts.dry-run:pages: wrangler pages functions build functions --outdir dist/_worker-build --compatibility-date 2026-01-01
scripts.deploy:dry-run: npm run typecheck && npm run dry-run:worker && npm run dry-run:pages
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run prepare:dist && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name cloud-monitor-api --branch main
